newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Demand in EDP OPV exceeds supply 37 times.
newsitem.headline: Demand in EDP OPV exceeds supply 37 times.

text.p: Demand in the public offer for sale (OPV) in the partial privatisation of state utility EDP- Electricidade de Portugal exceeded the available supply of shares by 37 times, bourse officials said.
Total demand in the OPV stood at 3.609588175 billion shares, compared with a supply of 97.4 million shares.

Demand in the tranche reserved for employees stood at 33,531,175 shares for an available supply of 5.7 million shares and demand in the small investors' and emigrants' category was 1.477834250 billion shares for a supply of 54 million shares, bourse officials said.
Demand in the bondholders' tranche was 19,172,150 for a supply of 300,000 shares and in the general public category demand stood at 2.079050 billion shares for a supply of 37.4 million shares.
